page_title: FastoNoSQL - GUI manager for NoSQL databases.

summary.name: FastoNoSQL
summary.one_liner: FastoNoSQL is a cross-platform GUI manager and IDE for NoSQL key-value databases such as Redis, Memcached, SSDB, LevelDB and RocksDB.
use_cases: Browsing and running commands against a Redis server
Managing several Redis or Memcached servers in one app
Connecting to a Redis Cluster as a single server
Accessing a database over an SSH tunnel
Monitoring Redis server history via logged info snapshots
Administering LevelDB, RocksDB or LMDB stores from a desktop GUI
summary.what_it_does: FastoNoSQL embeds the redis-cli engine, offering syntax highlighting, autocompletion for Redis commands, and text, tree and table view modes. Each tab is a separate shell, so multiple shells can be opened against one or many servers. It can discover and work with Redis Cluster nodes as one server and connect over SSH tunnels using password or private key authentication. With logging enabled on the connection dialog, it runs redis info every minute and saves the results to show server history graphs. The page says it supports Memcached, SSDB and other key-value stores, and that the project is extensible to future databases.
notable: Embeds the redis-cli engine with autocompletion and syntax highlighting
Supports Redis Cluster discovery and SSH tunnel connections
Open source and cross-platform desktop client
Logs redis info snapshots every minute for history graphs
caveats: A PRO version is mentioned, but its features and pricing are not described on the page
Page warns the shell will not stop users from running destructive commands
